### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports OCSP checks to determine whether a TLS certificate has been revoked.

### Problem Description

OCSP validation verified the response signature without consistently checking that the response described the certificate being evaluated. A valid response for another certificate from the same issuer could therefore be accepted. Under the required conditions, a revoked certificate could pass the affected revocation check.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-65q4-982r-rm5c>
 * Credit: ARSB (@ARSB1)
repo.summary: OCSP responses were not bound to the certificate being checked
